profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at SimpliSafe
profile.summary:
A Software Engineer, building and working with modern web tools such as React.js, Typescript, and JavaScript. I have a strong focus on developing responsive and accessible sites that meet today's and tomorrow's standards.

Mixing Engineering and design is my passion. Great design and intuitive engineering lead to the highest quality product. Those are the base standards I work with.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborate with UX designers and researchers, and translate their designs into high-quality, well-architected applications.

Develop and maintain testing approaches to ensure that our tools and services are maintainable and continue to perform at their peak into he future.

Work with backend engineers to design fit-for-purpose APIs to power the experiences that you’re building.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintain the structure of the SimpliSafe website, as well as organize and build UI modules, working closely with UX and Project Managers to help guide the creation of SimpliSafe's next generation E-Commerce Platform.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: WordPress theme developer working with modern HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, and Javascript standards. Worked with graphic designers, project mangers, and clients to develop sites of various sizes and scale. All sites are built with mobile first Frontend Frameworks such as Foundation 6. SEO tools incorporated onto all sites such as Yoast, as well as Google Analytics for improved SEO value. Sites tested for all browsers down to IE9 and mobile responsiveness. Animations added to sites on a design bases, using standards that work on all device types.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Providence County, Rhode Island, United States
positions.description: Assist Web developers developing in-house line of business applications. Applicant will gain experience in all phases of the web development life cycle, as well as excellent understanding of how to translate customer needs and business strategy into well formed and documented Web Applications. Examples include troubleshooting bugs, extending existing functionality, documenting existing features, upgrading front end to be web browser agnostic.

positions.title: Johnson & Wales Computer Lab Assistant
positions.locationName: Providence County, Rhode Island, United States
positions.description: Provide technical support to staff, faculty, and students with relations to visual-audio technology in the classrooms. Be acquainted with the available help resources, campus technology changes and issues. Perform regular cleaning and testing of department managed technologies.

positions.title: Data Entry
positions.description: Data entry, Valet service, Dispatch, Graphic Design

honors.title: Deans List
honors.description: For excelling in grades and proudly representing Johnson and Wales as a student.
honors.issuer: Issued by Francis X. Tweedie · Nov 2014

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteering at the Pocono Medical Center was phenomenal. The staff there were all so kind. I learned about the structure of the hospital and grew to appreciate the hard work done by the staff and the other volunteers.

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.description: Creating a professional portfolio using Foundation 5 and using the resources from Foundation to code my portfolio. All the work done in the site was made by myself for school over the last two years.

projects.title: Portfolio, Franklin Farms, Holiday Card Set, Quench, Quiddity, RambleOn Tours
projects.description: I designed and coded each part of these projects on my own using the tools provided from Adobe Creative Suite, and Google Chrome.
